title: bee-write-guard port 2 of 3 — Bash path: extractBashTargets, checkGitBashCommand, internals-reach, CLI-shape
action: Port the Bash-command analysis path of bee-write-guard (split 2 of 3): extractBashTargets (write-target extraction from shell commands incl. redirects, heredocs, env prefixes, subshells — the guards.mjs tokenize source of truth, rust tokenizer from rust-port-8), checkGitBashCommand incl. bsg-1 blanket-staging flags counted as broad writes and git-mutation path resolution — GIT SPAWN PARITY per validation decision 2026-07-26: rust spawns git exactly where node does (fires only on git-mutation-shaped commands, common hot path stays spawn-free; gix revisit noted for flip slice); git-bash fixtures use GIT-INITIALIZED temp roots (rig detail: plain seeded roots have no .git and the git path never engages), internals-reach guard (node eval imports of bin/lib or packages/bee/lib denied with the paved-read message), and CLI-shape validation (bee.mjs invocations tokenized and validated against the rust-port-8 registry bridge incl. required-flag checks; validate-args semantics). STALE-REGISTRY SEMANTICS (advisor note 2 — two distinct fixtures, never one symmetric diff): (a) rust-side stale-cache fixture: registry cache sha mismatches the seeded command-registry.mjs — rust skips CLI-shape with a coverage-gap line; this is an ACCEPTED rust-only allow window, asserted rust-side only; (b) node-side import-failure fixture: the seeded command-registry.mjs is removed/corrupted — node skips with its own coverage-gap; the two fixtures are separate proofs, not one diffed pair, and neither may be satisfied by a benign command on an intact root. Exit contract exact (allow 0 silent, deny 2 stderr reason, crash 0 fail-open). CONFORMANCE via the rust-port-7 rig (full RIG DISCIPLINE inherited: sha256-verified seeds, allow-with-twin-deny pairing, non-trivial node verdicts, per-class fixture names in output) in ONE integration target writeguard_bash; verify prefixes the registry dump so every temp root can seed a fresh cache. Deny-preservation red-first mandatory.

truths: cargo --test writeguard_bash runs (missing target exits 101) and reports at least 15 passed, output listing fixture names per class: extract-targets, git-bash incl. blanket staging, internals-reach, CLI-shape valid and invalid, stale-cache rust-side, node import-failure
every deny fixture: node oracle exit 2 asserted, rust matches exit and reason class
stale-cache fixture is rust-side only (accepted allow window, coverage-gap line asserted); node import-failure fixture is separate
crash fixtures exit 0 with crash line

artifacts.substantive: bash target extraction, git-bash check, internals-reach, CLI-shape validation
bash path wired into write-guard hook plus writeguard_bash corpus
